windowTreatment.recommendation: Ivory sheers + hidden privacy shades; no mandatory blackout
windowTreatment.coverage: Terrace-facing glazing. Leave the two high horizontal transoms beside the fireplace bare unless glare or a neighboring sightline requires treatment.
windowTreatment.why: This is a social room with a TV, so flexible glare control and evening privacy matter more than cinema-level darkness. The airy main-floor appearance stays intact.
windowTreatment.day: Sheers diffuse sun; adjust the privacy shade where glare reaches the TV.
windowTreatment.night: Close privacy shades when the room is visible from outside.
windowTreatment.installation: Coordinate a traversing solution at operable terrace glass; stacks must clear handles and passage. Quote a blackout-fabric upgrade separately only if daytime TV testing shows it is wanted. High-transom treatment is not assumed in the base allowance.
